integrity: Exact finite-field and integer calculations rerun from a standalone package. No external or independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact graph-spectral and pair-incidence refinement of the Rams--Schuett 60-line quartic; geometric completeness and smoothness use published antecedents. Does not classify all K3 surfaces, determine the full graph automorphism group, or claim independently verified historical priority. Geometric configuration could encode the invariants implicitly.
title: Spectrum and transversal geometry of the sixty-line characteristic-two quartic
